prompt.utterance: Explain why the guide says the timeout is 30 seconds while src/config.py sets 10.

graderOnly: The active cycle's technical design (.standards/docs/specs/lower-provider-timeout-20260922T141000Z-5c81e0a3.md) specifies a 10-second request timeout, and src/config.py implements it: REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS was 30 in the initial commit and became 10 in the commit 'Lower provider request timeout to 10 seconds'.
docs/guide.md has not changed since the initial commit; its 30-second statement describes the pre-cycle baseline and is outdated.

Correcting the guide is project documentation work owned by Documenter; DOCUMENTING is a later phase of this STANDARD cycle. The workflow is currently in DEVELOPING, owned by Developer, with DEV-002 still pending.
Neither the scope nor the design mentions the guide.
